geographic_roles.rule: Use full 500x500 WTK window separated by >=80 grid cells; no external prediction access before frozen metric/model/mask/aggregation protocol.

limitations: Original PhIRE pretrained-model patch membership unknown; claims restricted to geographic/temporal separation from our fine-tuning.
Four development fields in XC were only a smoke test; cannot infer population effects.
Spatial WTK coordinate grid is non-trivial: 500-cell tiles and model arrays must be geospatially calibrated before physical displacement in km.
A single 3-epoch fine-tuning trajectory per arm does not establish seed-wise robustness.

canonical_topology.aggregation: Use paired GT/model distance per exact field (H0 and H1 combined by identical historical rule); lower is better.
canonical_topology.pd: Reuse corrected Phase 6 canonical TTK extraction and GUDHI parsing/conventions with essential-pair treatment and per-dimension decomposition validated before external evaluation.
canonical_topology.scalar: speed=sqrt(u^2+v^2) in m/s computed after full-field inference

distributed_tile_sensitivity.evaluation: Nine predeclared nonoverlapping tiles from the SAME full500 model predictions; treat tiles as clustered under parent field, not independent hourly cases.

full500_topology_pilot.caution: PD of complete 500x500 field is not union of tile PDs; compare models within spatial support, not raw topology costs across supports.
full500_topology_pilot.scope: Predeclare a fixed development field subset by region/time before extraction; report TTK extraction success, feature count, runtime, memory and solver feasibility; never silently promote pilot metrics to primary.

merge_tree.caution: Do not treat historic MT distance code as independently validated or claim MT results until a numerical synthetic reference gate passes.

primary_reconstruction.aggregation: Compute per-field metrics, aggregate means within 168-hour region-season blocks, then balanced means across regions/seasons; do not pool all pixels as statistically independent.
primary_reconstruction.uv_rmse_mps: sqrt(mean((prediction_uv-reference_uv)^2)) over both vector channels and complete 500x500 field

spatial_locality.aggregation: Per-field region-week comparisons; do not convert pixels to km without validated geometry and orientation.
spatial_locality.rule: A GT/SR feature match is admissible iff both birth and death vertex Euclidean separations are <= r; preserve original W22 cost and diagonal allowances.
spatial_locality.solver: Reuse frozen Phase5E sparse locality solver with validated Phase 6 LXXXII/LXXXIII infinity regression.

models.architecture: Native PhIREGANs.test_paired MR->HR r=[5], pretrained mu=[0.7684,-0.4575] sigma=[5.02455,5.9017], batch_size=1.
models.checkpoints: Reuse the exact six XC source SHA-indexed checkpoint prefixes and bytes, no retraining, model selection or test-time adaptation.
models.data: 100x100x2 MR factor-five average pooling from complete 500x500x2 native HR; predict full 500x500 [u,v], then crop for topology.

predeclared_comparisons.question: Does gradient fine-tuning retain better pointwise quality than pretrained CNN?
Do global topology rankings from 2007 persist by geographical block?
Does gradient beat PERS under tight locality while PERS beats gradient at infinity?
Does adversarial CNN/GAN trade-off vary by region?

purpose: Test transfer of frozen PhIRE CNN/GAN and 2x2 CNN fine-tuning family beyond documented 2007 fine-tuning geography and time, without claiming pretrained-data novelty

statistics.external_test_policy: No model tuning or new metric choices in response to locked 2010 scores; analyze the predeclared 2012 replication without reselecting windows.
statistics.uncertainty: Report between-block variation; any bootstrap must resample whole region-week blocks with small-cluster caveat; no hour-wise independence claims or posthoc significance thresholds.
statistics.unit_of_aggregation: Region-by-seven-day-week block, equal block weight; n=8 blocks per role per year (2 regions x 4 seasonal weeks).
statistics.unit_of_pairing: Identical WTK region/time/field and tile when applicable

times.inclusion: All predeclared hours are included. Failed samples must be logged by region/time/index with reason; no silent removal or replacement.
times.reporting: Analyze 2010 primary and 2012 replication separately before any combined summary.

validation_gates: source and checkpoint byte continuity with verified XC pilot
WTK row-column orientation, original normalization and full500 paired inference continuity
exact region IDs and timestamp indices according to LXXXIX frozen split
synthetic/past-result parity for PD distances and locality solver before external use
document model inference runtime and scientific feasibility on DEVELOPMENT fields
halt on any nonfinite model output, field orientation mismatch, or input/GT numerical discrepancy
all external results written once to isolated SHA-indexed directories; no overwrite
